examples.title: Skeleton placeholders
examples.description: Animated loading placeholders for text and avatars.

examples.title: Lines and card
examples.description: lines stacks text bars; variant="card" draws a heading bar and lines inside a card.

examples.title: Loading rules
examples.description: Nothing for 300 ms, the skeleton until 10 seconds, then Still loading with Cancel.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, Skeleton } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  let loading = $state(false);
</script>

<Button label="Start loading" onclick={() => (loading = true)} disabled={loading} />

{#if loading}
  <Skeleton lines={5} delay={300} stillLoadingAfter={10000} onCancel={() => (loading = false)} />
{/if}

examples.title: Grouped list loading
examples.description: The grouped variant draws a grouped list's rows on its rounded surface, separators inset at the text. With action, each row keeps a block where its button goes, and on a phone the block drops under the text at its own width.

examples.title: List loading and slow loading
examples.description: The list variant keeps each row’s status column reserved, then draws two text bars and a time bar, with no circle, so nothing shifts when the data arrives. The region is announced as "Loading agents" with no spinner. After the slow-loading time its own status line and a ghost Cancel take the first row's place; it is not a banner.
